answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using memory-hard proofs, requiring participants to continuously read from locked random-access tables. An adversary cannot cheaply forge identities across the agent meadow, because allocating gigabytes per persona demands an onyx array of physical RAM chips. This forces attackers to incur verifiable capital expenses for dedicated silicon. However, this approach penalizes lightweight honest agents operating on resource-constrained devices.
